description: This file defines structures, macros, and function declarations for managing reverse indexes (revindex) related to Git pack files, including loading, verifying, and converting pack and object positions within packs or multi-pack indexes.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex
methods.description: Loads the reverse index data structures for a given pack in the repository, returning 0 on success or a negative value on failure.

methods.name: load_pack_revindex_from_disk
methods.description: Specifically loads a pack's reverse index from disk, returning 0 on success, 1 if the .rev file is absent, or -1 on parse error.

methods.name: verify_pack_revindex
methods.description: Verifies that the on-disk reverse index for a pack matches a freshly created one, returning a negative value on error.

methods.name: load_midx_revindex
methods.description: Loads the reverse index for a multi-pack index by mmap-ing its .rev file, returning a negative value on error or a positive value if no reverse index exists.

methods.name: close_midx_revindex
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a multi-pack reverse index, returning a negative number on error.

methods.name: offset_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts an object offset to a pack position, loading the reverse index lazily if needed, returning 0 on success or a negative number on error.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_index
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to an index-relative position within the pack.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_offset
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position to a byte offset within the pack.

methods.name: pack_pos_to_midx
methods.description: Converts a pack-relative position in the MIDX to a MIDX index position.

methods.name: midx_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a MIDX position to a pack position.

methods.name: midx_pair_to_pack_pos
methods.description: Converts a pack ID and offset to a pack position in the MIDX.
